rules.description: Exact backend snapshot producers: validate freeze/reuse/integrity in backend tests; deployed entry validation remains deployment-scoped. Other acceptance entry scripts retain browser and namespace requirements.
Internal Primitive Port, Provider and Scene adapter conformance has no product-page consumer; it requires contract/static verification but does not invalidate list-surface runtime evidence.
Adding a @sc/ui export subpath cannot change an existing consumer; dependency/manifest changes outside exports fall through to the conservative frontend-runtime rule.
Backend capability acceptance contract data; backend contract verification only, not frontend browser evidence.

Navigation membership, company scope and publication diagnosis: backend/managed navigation ORM, not list geometry or relation-field roundtrip. No wildcard exemption for scene orchestration or business models.

Native catalog maintenance, publication qualification and its ORM regression. Backend contract coverage; no list layout or relation-field behavior. Exact paths only; mixed business changes retain their own suites.

Approval policy step seed initialization and maintenance authority (forcecreate=0, install-only initializer). Backend contract coverage; no list layout or relation-field behavior. Exact paths only; mixed business changes retain their own suites.
Change confined to ScApprovalPolicy.apply_user_visible_approval_templates. Backend contract coverage; any other method change in the shared model file keeps construction-product-runtime suites.

analysis_coverage.warning: P4-00 enumerates direct declarations and partial static signals. It does not establish assertion-level obligation coverage or duplicate assertions.

long_tail_boundary.cannot_support_claim: A long-tail script cannot support merge or delivery evidence until a workflow or governed lane actually dispatches it and its receipt is current.
long_tail_boundary.definition: Make targets or scripts not reachable from the four declared gate anchors. They may be manual, diagnostic, runtime, deployment, legacy or dead surface.

method.make_graph: Parsed by scripts/audit/verification_lane_coverage.py from Makefile and make/*.mk
method.resource_inference: Keyword/resource signals are evidence hints, not proof of execution. not_statically_detected means the repository metadata does not establish the dependency.
method.semantic_inference: Module docstrings/header comments and executable commands are cited. No verification responsibility is accepted from a filename alone.
method.verification_item: A workflow job, automated make anchor/target, gate-enforced executable, acceptance suite, or explicitly classified long-tail guard.
method.workflow_graph: Parsed from all .github/workflows/*.yml jobs and steps

part_policy: Large inventories are split into bounded files below the repository 5 MiB history-scan threshold. Each part retains the same verification boundary answers; the index is not a reduction of coverage.
